mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, PRODUCT_TYPE, MAX_LIMIT_AMOUNT, BASE_RATE, MIN_RATE, MAX_RATE, USE_YN, CREATED_AT FROM JEONSE_LOAN_PRODUCT WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO JEONSE_LOAN_PRODUCT (PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, PRODUCT_TYPE, MAX_LIMIT_AMOUNT, BASE_RATE, MIN_RATE, MAX_RATE, USE_YN, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{productId}, #{productName}, #{productType}, #{maxLimitAmount}, #{baseRate}, #{minRate}, #{maxRate}, #{useYn}, #{createdAt})
